LESSON: HANDLING THE BIBLE BIBLE

Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HOLY
Topic 2.2: Handling the Bible BIBLE

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Handling the Bible BIBLE. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify different ways of handling the Bible as a Holy book used by Christians to nurture a sense of responsibility the Bible with care 171
2. demonstrate different ways of handling the Bible with care to promote respect for the word of God
3. sing simple songs on how to handle the Bible
4. desire to handle the Bible with respect as a Holy book e) appreciate the importance of handling the Bible as part of his/her self-discipline

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify different ways of handling the Bible as a Holy book used by Christians to nurture a sense of responsibility the Bible with care 171
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify different ways of handling the Bible as a Holy book used by Christians to nurture a sense of responsibility the Bible with care 171. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate different ways of handling the Bible with care to promote respect for the word of God
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate different ways of handling the Bible with care to promote respect for the word of God. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. sing simple songs on how to handle the Bible
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to sing simple songs on how to handle the Bible. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. desire to handle the Bible with respect as a Holy book e) appreciate the importance of handling the Bible as part of his/her self-discipline
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to desire to handle the Bible with respect as a Holy book e) appreciate the importance of handling the Bible as part of his/her self-discipline. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”
